title: Policy Record
description: The Evidence state variable: a versioned statement of the propositions that justify an authority grant. Policy is state, not input (Law III). A policy record carries its own assumptions, review triggers, and expiry so that when the evidentiary state changes materially, every grant that depends on it becomes eligible for reconsideration.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

policy_id.title: Policy identifier
policy_id.description: Stable identifier for the policy, referenced by grants and decision records.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version of the policy content. A new version is a new evidentiary state.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short human-readable name of the policy.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Who adopted the policy, when, and on what evidence.

author.title: Author
author.description: Person or body accountable for the policy content.

evidence_refs.title: Evidence references
evidence_refs.description: Identifiers or URLs of the evidence items the policy rests on.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: Propositions assumed true for the policy to remain valid.

review_triggers.title: Review triggers
review_triggers.description: Observations that must change the policy's status. An observation that cannot change state is theater (Law VIII).

items.title: Review trigger
items.description: One condition that moves the policy into review, suspension, or retirement.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What class of observation fires the trigger.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Plain-language or expression form of the threshold that fires the trigger.

action.title: Action
action.description: The status transition the trigger forces.

expires_at.title: Expires at
expires_at.description: When the policy lapses unless re-adopted. Grants resting on an expired policy move to review_required.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current evidentiary status of the policy.

supersedes.title: Supersedes
supersedes.description: Identifier and version of the policy record this one replaces, if any.
